# Negotiation against a stand-in target with no system libraries.
#
# Note what is NOT announced: no `resolve`, because this part has none of the platform's
# libraries to resolve against. A driver discovers that here rather than assuming it, and
# a question about library behaviour is refused rather than answered wrongly.
CMD|1|hello|1
OBS|ack|1|hello
OBS|hello|1|f1a2b3c4|call,read,blob,reset,report,gpu
OBS|part|f1a2b3c4|target|deck
OBS|part|f1a2b3c4|gpu|AMD Custom GPU 0405 (gfx1033)
OBS|part|f1a2b3c4|driver|radv 25.1.0
OBS|part|f1a2b3c4|mesa|25.1.0
OBS|part|f1a2b3c4|os|SteamOS 3.6.20
OBS|part|f1a2b3c4|probe|dev
OBS|done|1|ok||
